profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Carrot
profile.summary:
Full-stack engineer, former nurse, and professional "I wonder how that works?" person.

I grew up in Huntsville, Alabama 🚀—NASA, aerospace, and engineers—which made curiosity my default setting. I haven't built any rockets (yet).

Instead, I followed my curiosity from nursing into software engineering—and eventually fintech. It's a lot less aerodynamic, but the debugging is probably similar.
